title: ABBA Reasoning Assurance Substrate Binding
rules: Epistemic categories remain distinct and ordered.
Skipped epistemic categories are allowed; backward transitions are not.
DECISION must be terminal in the reasoning sequence.
A DECISION requires an authority reference, consent reference and explicit authority signature.
The independent Authority + Policy + Consent Gate must ALLOW before canonical event emission.
The binder never writes canonical tables directly.
Reasoning-chain audit persistence is idempotent and RLS protected.
Canonical event persistence uses the existing canonical event writer and staged append_canonical_event ingress.
